name: invoice-preview
prompt: open http://127.0.0.1:5431/t/invoice-preview/ in {browser}, download the invoice PDF, open that file in Preview (not the browser) and read the invoice total from Preview. save a copy of the PDF as {out}/invoice.pdf. remove any other downloaded copy, including one in Downloads
result: the invoice total as shown in Preview

name: table-textedit
prompt: open http://127.0.0.1:5431/t/table-textedit/ in {browser} and copy the roster table. in TextEdit, make a new plain-text document, paste the table, and save it as {out}/roster.txt
result: the three names and their hours

name: mailto-draft
prompt: open http://127.0.0.1:5431/t/mailto-draft/ in {browser} and click Email billing. in Mail, add the exact line "Confirming INV-4419, do not send" to the draft body. do not send the message
result: the To address and subject of the draft, and that it was not sent
